Alan Rivera: note — keep model pin for at least 1h after we hit 50% before unpinning to avoid drift during warmup
Priya Singh: watching generation-quality (BLEU/ROUGE proxies + new hallucination signal). If gen-quality drops >3 pts, call rollback
